lesson.title: Der erste Arbeitstag

sentences.text: Am ersten Arbeitstag hat Leo die neue Firma kennengelernt und seine Chefin an der Rezeption getroffen.
sentences.natural_meaning: On his first day at work, Leo got to know the new company and met his manager at reception.

verb_help.usage: The sentence uses the present tense for a current action, routine, plan, or general fact.
kennengelernt is the past participle of kennenlernen; it combines with haben to form the conversational past.
getroffen is the past participle of treffen; it combines with haben to form the conversational past.

items.english: Leo got to know the new company and met his manager at reception

sentences.text: Sie hat ihm bei der Einführung die Abteilung und die Arbeitszeit erklärt.
sentences.natural_meaning: She explained the department and working hours to him during orientation.

sentences.text: Danach hat er sich bei seinen Kollegen vorgestellt und ihre Namen sofort vergessen.

sentences.text: Am Nachmittag hat er Verantwortung für ein Projekt übernommen; das war interessant.
sentences.natural_meaning: In the afternoon, he took responsibility for a project; that was interesting.

sentences.natural_meaning: That evening Leo says: The company has three departments, and the orientation was good; where will I work tomorrow?

lesson.initial_question: Which four things happened during Leo's first day?
lesson.initial_answer: He got to know the company, met his manager, introduced himself to colleagues, and received a task.
lesson.topic: reporting the steps of workplace orientation

performance_activity.instruction: Listen and order four events. Then identify which line states a workplace fact rather than an event Leo experienced.
prompts: The manager explains the department and working hours.
